name: PR Overview shows the Blast radius block with an honest degraded state
description: Open PR #482 (lands on the Overview tab by default) and confirm the Blast radius block renders from GET /pulls/:id/blast. The seeded repo acme/payments-api has no clone and no repo-intel index (clonePath: null in seed.ts), so repo-intel's facade returns degraded:true / reason:'no_data' — the block must say so instead of rendering an empty map, and offer the Rebuild index action. The section label is CSS-uppercased, so the flow anchors on the degraded body text, never on the title. It does NOT click Rebuild index: that enqueues a resync job, and flows stay read-only. Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
